author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.8.0 — cleanNextRooms() now excludes whatever's already actively being cleaned from candidate selection, so a repeat call while a batch is still running advances to the next rotation group instead of re-picking (and re-dispatching) the same rooms, which previously looked like it did nothing. Also adds markRoomsCleaned(roomNames) to manually correct rotation history for a room that was genuinely cleaned but never got recorded, without dispatching any actual cleaning.
